title: Google AdWords for salons: how to make $3,600 in bookings with $175 in ads

facts.fact: According to the page, citing mainstreetroi.com, 71% of ads on the internet are done through Google.
facts.quote: 71% of the ads on the internet are done through Google

facts.fact: According to the page, citing mainstreetroi.com, businesses on average make $2 for every $1 they spend on AdWords.
facts.quote: On average, businesses make $2 for every $1 they spend on AdWords

facts.fact: According to the page, citing mainstreetroi.com, 72% of potential clients prefer to find information about local businesses via search.
facts.quote: 72% of your potential clients prefer to find information about local businesses like yours via search

facts.fact: The page states, without naming a source, that 98% of searchers choose a business that is on page 1 of the results they get.
facts.quote: 98% of those searchers choose a business that is on page 1 of the results they get.

facts.fact: The page states that Robert Norberciak's day spa, Mozaik Skin & Body, grew from $5,800 per month to $70,000 per month in a few years (vendor-reported anecdote, not independently verified).
facts.quote: took it from $5,800/mo to $70,000/mo in just a few years.

facts.fact: The page reports that Mozaik's couples massage Google Ads campaign had 92 clicks from Google.
facts.quote: Clicks on the ad from Google:** 92

facts.fact: The page reports that the couples massage campaign cost $175 in total.
The page reports that the couples massage campaign produced 31 total conversions, which it describes as bookings, equal to 34%.
facts.quote: Total conversions** (how many people booked an appointment): 31 (34%)

facts.fact: The page reports that the couples massage campaign generated $3,689 in revenue from 31 people who spent $119 each.
The page states that each new booking from the campaign cost $5.60 and had a value of $119.

The article's headline and section heading claim roughly $3,600 in bookings or revenue from less than $200 in ad spend, which is a vendor headline figure that differs from the $3,689 revenue stated in the body.
facts.quote: how to make $3,600 in bookings with $175 in ads

facts.fact: The page's advice for landing pages includes having no menu links except for the call to action.
facts.quote: No menu links except for your call to action
